"Regular stretch rules for tag checks"
This part of the manual describes the standard that applies

Section title: Companion Animal Travel Desk conduct for pet handoffs

Purpose: This section sets a calm, practical standard for pet handoffs, lounge use, and service follow-through at Aurelia Skyways.

Staff should keep communication prompt, respectful, and plain. We are sorry when a traveler has to ask twice, so the desk must give clear guidance the first time, confirm each pet's needs without fuss, and keep the process steady from check-in to boarding. When a traveler arrives with a carrier, the desk should verify documents, tag status, and handling notes, then explain the next step in simple language. If a pet needs a relief stop, staff should give directions without delay and stay attentive to the traveler's comfort and the animal's condition.

For shared spaces, the Companion Animal Travel Desk must keep access orderly and quiet. <<FACT F018>> Staff should treat that detail as internal reference only and keep the conversation focused on the traveler's immediate needs. In the same spirit, any lounge support must remain courteous and practical. <<FACT F002>> The desk should never leave a traveler guessing about where to wait, who to speak with, or what happens next.

If a traveler is upset, the best practice is to listen, restate the concern in plain words, and offer the next workable step. Do not overpromise. Do not improvise rules. Do not make a pet wait longer than needed when a safe path is available. The desk should note unusual handling needs right away and pass them along to the next team with care.

Any missed step, unclear handoff, or lapse in tone should be corrected as soon as noticed, because this service is shared work and each journey matters. Please contact the senior coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk for clarification or follow-up.
